request.spec:

(each sheet's lines newest first, sheets by id, after this sheet's own lines and before the lines
from the sheet a person came from).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The audit viewer, filtered by a name, now also lists the matching lines of the sheet's descendants
(each sheet's lines newest first, sheets by id, after this sheet's own lines and before the lines
from the sheet a person came from).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

agent.result_text:
When you filter the audit viewer by a name, it now also lists the matching lines from the sheet's descendants. All 4 Playwright tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

The change is all on the server, in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/audit/AuditViewService.java`. The order of lines is now:
1. this sheet's own matching lines, newest first;
2. the matching lines of each descendant (children, grandchildren and so on), one sheet at a time with sheets sorted by id, each sheet's lines newest first;
3. the lines from the sheet a person came from, as before.

Descendants come from the existing `SheetParentRepository.descendantsOf`. With no name filter, the viewer shows only this sheet's lines, as the test expects.

The front end and stored data didn't need changing. Nothing new is written to the audit file. I also updated the doc comment in `AuditViewController.java` to describe the new behaviour.
